c: p:she-ra and the princesses of power
d:
This is going to be an on-going series of She-Ra doodles. Newer artwork would be posted at the end of each Themes/Characters, most of the times, because it's just easier for me to organize it like that at this point. I mean I could say fuck that and just drop them all at the last page, but then my OCD would be kicking in high gear, and I won't sleep at night. So bear with me with that.

My personal head canon: Double Trouble would switch genitals depending on if they want to be on top or on bottom. But sometimes they would switch around to be different.
